h1:
10 Most Popular Hotels
in Phayao Province
That We've Already Reviewed
heroSub: We've picked 10 Phayao stays we've already reviewed in depth — a downtown boutique within walking distance of Kwan Phayao, a Japanese-style garden resort near Phayao University, a treehouse farmstay in a teak forest, a garden homestay halfway between Phayao and Nan, and a quiet, easy-on-the-wallet guesthouse. Prices start at around ฿500–1,290/night.
introH2: 🏞️ How many kinds of Phayao stays are there, and how do you pick the right one for your trip?
introHtml: Phayao is a small, quiet town whose heart is Kwan Phayao, the largest freshwater lake in northern Thailand — and that's what makes choosing a place to stay here different from a typical tourist town. Phayao stays don't all look the same. Some are modern downtown boutiques where you open the curtains in the morning to mist over the lake and can walk to the night market. Some are Japanese-style garden resorts or treehouse farmstays out by Phayao University, selling quiet and privacy. And some are garden homestays as far out as Chiang Muan district, halfway to Nan. A lot of people book a Phayao stay without checking the location carefully, then find themselves driving into town several times a day — or the opposite, wanting quiet but ending up on a busy road in the center. This article gathers 10 Phayao stays we've already reviewed in depth — downtown by the lake, around Phayao University, and out of town. Every one is based on reading real guest reviews, telling you both the good points and the honest caveats, comparing prices across 3 sites, with direct booking links throughout.
mrtHtml: Phayao has no airport of its own and not much public transport in town. The nearest, most convenient airport is Chiang Rai (CEI), about 90 km away — roughly an hour and a half by car or minibus. From Chiang Mai it's about a 3-hour drive. Having your own car is the most convenient, since many stays are outside the walkable area. The areas covered in this article: City center · by Kwan Phayao — walk to the lake, the night market, and restaurants, no driving needed (Phuglong, M2, Green Hill, Sabuy Best) · Mae Ka subdistrict · Phayao University side — quiet garden resorts and farmstays, about 18–20 km from town, a car is needed (Zen Home, MonSamKien) · Outskirts · out of town — Mae Puem, Ban Tam, Tha Wang Thong, quiet and cheap, good if you have a car (I Ya, DD Garden, Kanlaya) · Chiang Muan district — further out, halfway between Phayao and Nan, good for a stopover (Baan Suan Siri).

entries.name: Zen Home Resort & Garden @ Phayao
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mae Ka · near Phayao University ~2 km · 18–20 km from town
entries.addr: 224 Moo 1, Ban Mo Kaeng Thong, Mae Ka, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: We open our 10 Phayao stays with an option that's clearly different from the rest — Zen Home Resort & Garden @ Phayao is a small garden resort of about 9 rooms, opened in 2023 in Mae Ka subdistrict on the Phayao University side, that many reviews single out as the kind of stay that wins over the right kind of guest. What gets people talking isn't the view or a pool, but something rare in an upcountry stay at this price: several of the rooms are spacious house- or cottage-style units that feel like a home, with a separate living room, their own kitchen, a big fridge, and a microwave, so you can comfortably cook or reheat your own meals. The decor is warm Japanese style — wood finishes, natural tones, and Zen-like simplicity — set in a leafy garden that several reviews describe as "more like staying at a Japanese-style guesthouse than a hotel." The thing praised most often in real reviews is the service — the owner is a Phayao University lecturer who looks after the place personally, along with student interns whom many guests describe as attentive and warm, like family. Prices start at around ฿1,200/night, with a real review score of about 8.2. Honest caveats from the reviews: the Mae Ka location is about 18–20 km (25–30 min drive) from town and Kwan Phayao, which isn't convenient without your own car; there's no pool; and as a new resort, some corners are still being finished. Best for families who want a large space with a kitchen, couples after quiet, and parents visiting or dropping off Phayao University students.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Not every room has a kitchen and living room, so specify a cottage or house when booking — then you can buy groceries at the PJ market in front of Phayao University and cook your own. Ask the resort about breakfast before booking, since the details differ between platforms.
pros: Several rooms are spacious houses with a separate living room and their own kitchen, so you can cook
Japanese Zen garden setting, quiet and private, rooms new and clean
The owner is a Phayao University lecturer who runs it personally, with warm, family-like service (per reviews)
Only about 2 km from Phayao University, handy for visiting or dropping off students
cons: About 18–20 km from town and Kwan Phayao, not convenient without a car
No pool, the focus is quiet and private space
A new resort, some corners still unfinished · breakfast details unclear (per reviews)

entries.name: Phuglong Hotel
entries.revCount: Trip.com 9.6 · about 41 reviews · TripAdvisor #1 B&B in Mueang Phayao
entries.badge: 🏙️ Highest score · walk to the lake
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chai Kwan Road · Mueang Phayao · 5-min walk to the lake
entries.addr: 888 Chai Kwan Road, Wiang, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: Among the 10 Phayao stays, if you go by real review scores, Phuglong Hotel is the top scorer in this article — Trip.com rates it about 9.6 from around 41 real guest reviews, and TripAdvisor ranks it #1 among B&Bs/guesthouses in Mueang Phayao. It's a modern boutique building of about 30 rooms on Chai Kwan Road in Wiang subdistrict, the lakefront road that's considered the heart of town. The number-one selling point reviews agree on is the location — only about 210 meters' walk to the Kwan Phayao waterfront, and under 5 minutes' walk to the Phayao night market and the city pillar shrine. Many guests say they love that you can "walk to everything," barely needing to call a ride the whole trip. The rooms are in a new building that many praise as clean, with big windows that let in light, and some rooms have a private balcony looking out over Kwan Phayao — the corner guests love most, opening the curtains in the morning to mist drifting over the water. There are bikes to borrow for riding along the lake, free parking, and free Wi-Fi. Standard rooms start at around ฿850/night. Honest caveats from the reviews: there are few power outlets in the rooms and the light switches aren't near the bed, Wi-Fi can be slow at times, some breakfast dishes arrive not very hot, and there's no pool. Best for couples, families, and city-walkers who want to use Phayao as a base for strolling, eating, and sightseeing by the water.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The lake view isn't in every room — specify a "lake-view/balcony room" when booking and confirm again before arrival. Bring a small power strip since outlets in the room are limited, and don't forget to borrow the hotel's bike for a ride along the lake in the evening.
pros: Top score in this article, Trip.com about 9.6 · TripAdvisor #1 B&B in Mueang Phayao
On the Chai Kwan lakefront road, a 5-min walk to Kwan Phayao and the night market
Modern, clean rooms with big windows, some with a balcony lake view
Bikes to borrow, free parking, and free Wi-Fi
cons: Few power outlets in the room, light switches not near the bed · Wi-Fi slow at times
Some breakfast dishes arrive not very hot (per reviews)
No pool · the lake view isn't in every room

entries.name: M2 Hotel Phayao
entries.revCount: Trip.com 8.2 · about 57 reviews · among the top in Mueang Phayao on TripAdvisor
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Pratu Klong 1 Road · city center · ~5-min drive to the lake
entries.addr: 23/3 Pratu Klong 1 Road, Wiang, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: M2 Hotel Phayao is a 3-star, 28-room hotel on Pratu Klong 1 Road in Wiang subdistrict that does the job of "a good in-town hotel" thoroughly, and has ranked among the top hotels in Mueang Phayao on TripAdvisor for years. Open since around 2015, it scores about 8.2 on Trip.com from over 50 reviewers. The main selling point is its city-center location — close to Kwan Phayao, the bus station, and the restaurant area, a short walk or drive of about 5 minutes to the lakefront. What road-trippers like most is that it has free private parking and even an EV charger, which isn't common at a small hotel at this price. Another quiet favorite is the breakfast at Happy Mori Cafe, served à la carte with a choice of over 30 menu items, and reviews often mention the "better-than-expected coffee." On the rooms, reviews agree they're clean and tidy, the beds are more comfortable than expected, and it's fairly quiet. Prices start at around ฿700/night. Honest caveats from the reviews: the building is starting to show its age and has no elevator, so rooms on floors 3–4 mean climbing the stairs, parking is limited when full, the à la carte breakfast means a wait when it's busy, and there's no pool or lake view from the rooms. Best for budget travelers who drive themselves, and anyone using Phayao as a stopover before heading on to Chiang Rai, Nan, or Chiang Mai.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: There's no elevator here, so if you'd rather not haul luggage up the stairs, ask for a lower-floor room when booking or at check-in. Breakfast at Happy Mori Cafe is à la carte, so if you have an early start, order well ahead — and don't miss the coffee many guests praise.
pros: City-center location, walk to restaurants and ~5-min drive to Kwan Phayao
Clean, tidy rooms, comfortable beds, fairly quiet (often praised in reviews)
Free parking + EV charger · breakfast at Happy Mori Cafe with good coffee
Friendly, helpful staff, easy check-in · good value from around 700
cons: The building is getting old and has no elevator, upper-floor rooms mean stairs
Parking is limited, may be hard to find if you arrive late · à la carte breakfast means a wait when busy
No pool and no Kwan Phayao view from the rooms

entries.type: 3★ Hotel · in town, with a pool
entries.name: Green Hill Hotel Phayao
entries.revCount: Agoda 8.1 · about 120 reviews (most-reviewed in the set)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phahonyothin Road · Mueang Phayao · walk to the lake
entries.storyHtml: If the other downtown Phayao stays have no pool at all, Green Hill Hotel Phayao fills exactly that gap — a 3-star hotel of about 78 rooms on Phahonyothin Road in Wiang subdistrict, whose key difference from the other in-town stays is that it has an outdoor pool and a poolside cafe. And among these 10 stays, Green Hill is also the one with the most reviews, around 120, averaging about 8.1 — a sign that it's a busy, well-known place in town. The location is good for city sightseeing, a few minutes' walk to Kwan Phayao, near Wat Sri Khom Kham, and right by the Phayao night market held along the lake on Fridays and Saturdays. There are several room tiers, from Standard City View up to the Pool / Lake View rooms that look out over the pool and Kwan Phayao, the popular view room here. There's free parking for those who drive. Prices start at around ฿900/night. Honest caveats: it's a larger hotel than the other in-town boutiques, so the feel is more general hotel than small and cozy, and the average score sits at "good" rather than memorable — best for those who want an in-town stay with a pool to swim in on a modest budget, more than those after distinctive character.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want the view, choose a Pool / Lake View room that looks out over both the pool and Kwan Phayao. On Fridays and Saturdays there's a lakeside night market near the hotel, an easy walk for local food without driving.
pros: Has an outdoor pool and a poolside cafe, which the other in-town stays usually don't
Most reviews in the set, around 120, a well-known name in Mueang Phayao
City-center location, walk to Kwan Phayao and near the lakeside night market
Pool / Lake View rooms look out over the pool and the lake · free parking
cons: A larger hotel, with a more general feel than a small, cozy stay
The average score sits at "good" rather than memorable (per reviews)
Pool/lake views are only in some rooms, specify when booking

entries.type: Farmstay · treehouse in a teak forest
entries.name: MonSamKien Homestay
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mae Ka subdistrict · Mueang Phayao · near Phayao University ~6-min drive
entries.addr: 332/3 Moo 2, Ban Mae Ka Hua Thung, Mae Ka, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: If there's one stay in this set the kids won't want to leave, many reviews give it to MonSamKien Homestay — a treehouse farmstay in a teak forest in Mae Ka subdistrict, on the Phayao University side, that sells an experience more than just a bedroom. It scores about 9.0 on Booking and about 8.7 on Agoda from around 42 real guest reviews. What gets people talking is that it isn't a typical hotel or resort, but houses and treehouses with balconies reaching out over the teak forest, in a farm setting with plenty to do. Reviews mention horse riding, kayaking, and a homemade-pizza workshop that keep families and groups of friends busy all day without going anywhere. There are several room types, from a Budget Double up to a Suite where some packages include breakfast, drinks, homemade pizza, and horse riding, plus two-bedroom houses for larger families. The location is about a 6-minute drive from Phayao University. Prices start at around ฿1,290/night. Honest caveats: like the other Mae Ka stays, it's about a 15–25 minute drive from town and Kwan Phayao, best for those who drive; it's a farmstay built around nature and activities more than luxurious rooms; and with only a few units it fills up fast on holidays. Best for families with kids, groups of friends who want a farm experience, and anyone who wants a slow-life stay in nature.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Check whether the room package you book includes the activities (horse riding, kayaking, pizza-making) or costs extra, since each room includes different things. There are only a few units, so on a long weekend book ahead — and plan to drive yourself, since it's outside the walkable area.
pros: Treehouse farmstay in a teak forest, balconies over the forest, a natural setting
Lots of activities — horse riding, kayaking, and making your own homemade pizza, good for families
Good review scores, Booking about 9.0 · some packages include meals and activities
About a 6-minute drive from Phayao University
cons: In Mae Ka, about a 15–25 minute drive from town and Kwan Phayao, a car is needed
Built around the farm setting and activities more than luxurious rooms
Only a few units, fills up fast on holidays

entries.name: I Ya Guesthouse
entries.revCount: Agoda 9.8 · Booking 9.7 · about 16 reviews (highest score in the set)
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Mae Puem subdistrict · Phayao outskirts · 15–20-min drive from town
entries.addr: 103/1 Moo 15, Ban Pong Kluea Tai, Mae Puem, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: Among the 10 Phayao stays, if you go purely by average score, I Ya Guesthouse is the top scorer in this article — about 9.8 on Agoda and about 9.7 on Booking, which is very high even from a small base of around 16 reviews. It's a 2-star boutique guesthouse of just 4 rooms in Mae Puem subdistrict on the Phayao outskirts, run by an owner who looks after it personally. The reason for scores this high at an easy price is something reviews agree on — the rooms are spotless, almost new, with clean minimalist decor and a large bathroom, plus the owner's attentiveness, easy with only 4 rooms to mind. Many reviews say it feels like staying at a relative's house where the room has been prepared with care, more than a typical guesthouse — clean linens, a well-kept room scent, and quick, friendly replies when booking. The Mae Puem area is quiet, with the Mae Puem reservoir near the stay, and there's free parking at your door. It suits anyone who wants a clean, quiet bed from around ฿700/night. Rooms range from Standard Double and Standard Twin up to a more spacious Deluxe Room. Honest caveats from the reviews: this is a small guesthouse, not a hotel — no resort-style facilities, no pool or on-site restaurant — and it's on the outskirts, about a 15–20 minute drive from town and Kwan Phayao, so it's better for those with a car; and with only 4 rooms it fills up fast, so book ahead. Best for couples or travelers who value cleanliness, quiet, and the owner's close care over a central location or full facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With only 4 rooms and scores this high, it fills up fast — booking ahead is a big advantage. Plan to drive yourself, since it's on the outskirts about a 15–20 minute drive from Kwan Phayao, and there's free parking at your door.
pros: Highest review score in the set, Agoda about 9.8 · Booking about 9.7
Rooms spotless and almost new, minimalist decor, large bathroom
Owner-run with close attention thanks to just 4 rooms · quiet outskirts
Easy price from around 700 · free parking at your door
cons: A small guesthouse, no resort-style facilities
On the outskirts, about a 15–20 minute drive from town and Kwan Phayao, best with a car
Only 4 rooms, fills up fast, book ahead

entries.type: 3★ Garden Guesthouse · by the Ing River
entries.name: DD Garden Home Phayao
entries.badge: 🌿 Garden with a faux waterfall · friendly owner
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Ban Tam · by the Ing River · ~12–15-min drive from the lake
entries.addr: 229 Moo 13, Ban Tha Ruea, Phahonyothin Road, Ban Tam, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: DD Garden Home Phayao is a small resort-style garden guesthouse in the Ban Tam area by the Ing River that many reviews say feels more relaxing than its price suggests. It scores about 8.8 on Agoda and about 8.6 on Booking from around 18 real guest reviews. What sets it apart from a typical guesthouse is that the rooms are spacious, around 28–36 sq.m., and every room has a private balcony looking out over the garden — noticeably larger than a standard guesthouse room — and the grounds have a landscaped garden with a faux waterfall that's a popular spot to photograph and sit. Reviews mention the freshly made breakfast and the friendly, attentive owner as what makes it feel as warm as staying at a relative's house, with several noting the owner helps recommend restaurants and sights around the lake. There are several room types, from Standard Twin Beds and Deluxe King Bed up to Deluxe 3 Single Beds that sleeps more, good for a small group or a family who want to share one room. Prices start at around ฿900/night. It's in the Ban Tam area by the Ing River, about a 12–15 minute drive from town and Kwan Phayao — noticeably closer than the Mae Ka area — so it's an option that gives you both garden quiet and reasonable access to town. Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a small stay outside the center, better for those who drive than those without a car; the feel leans toward garden quiet more than full facilities; and with not many rooms, book ahead. Best for couples and families who want a spacious room with a balcony in a quiet garden setting that's still easy to reach town from.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you're coming as a group, choose the Deluxe 3 Single Beds room, which is spacious and sleeps more. The Ban Tam location is closer to town than the Mae Ka area, but you should still drive yourself — and don't miss the owner's freshly made breakfast.
pros: Spacious rooms around 28–36 sq.m., every room with a private garden-view balcony
Landscaped garden with a faux waterfall, quiet setting by the Ing River
Freshly made breakfast, friendly and attentive owner (per reviews)
Closer to town and Kwan Phayao than the Mae Ka area, about a 12–15 minute drive
cons: Outside the center, better for those who drive
Leans toward a garden, quiet setting more than full facilities
A small stay with not many rooms, book ahead

entries.name: Baan Suan Siri (Siri Garden)
entries.badge: ⛰️ Garden bungalows, mountain view · halfway Phayao–Nan
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Chiang Muan district · by Highway 1091 · ~1.5 hrs from Phayao town
entries.addr: 377 Moo 2, Chiang Muan, Chiang Muan district (by Highway 1091)
entries.storyHtml: Baan Suan Siri (Siri Garden) is a stay that differs from the others in this set by location, since it isn't in Phayao town or on the university side, but as far out as Chiang Muan district, by Highway 1091, which is halfway between Phayao and Nan. It's a garden homestay of bungalows in a mango and dragon-fruit orchard, scoring about 8.9 on Booking and about 8.7 on Agoda from around 41 real guest reviews. What reviews mention is the bungalows with balconies looking out at the mountains, the quiet garden setting, and the English-speaking owner — so a fair number of foreign guests stop here while traveling. Breakfast is included with the room, and there's free parking and free Wi-Fi. A location highlight is that it's only about 3–4 km from the Chiang Muan Dinosaur Museum, a fitting stopover for those driving the Phayao–Nan route, or a base for visiting Phu Langka. Prices start at around ฿1,150/night. Honest caveats: it's about a 1.5-hour drive from Phayao town and Kwan Phayao, so it isn't ideal if your main goal is to see the lake, and it's a small garden homestay built around a natural setting more than luxury. Best for those driving the Phayao–Nan route who want a quiet one-night stay in a mountain-view garden, or anyone visiting Chiang Muan district and the dinosaur museum directly.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Think of this as a stopover on the Phayao–Nan route more than a base for the lake, since it's about 1.5 hours from Phayao town. If you want the view, choose a Bungalow Mountain View, and ask the owner about availability ahead of time, since there are only a few bungalows.
pros: Bungalows in a mango orchard, balconies with mountain views, a quiet setting
Breakfast included · English-speaking owner who looks after guests well (per reviews)
A fitting stopover on the Phayao–Nan route · near the Chiang Muan Dinosaur Museum
Free parking and free Wi-Fi · prices from around 1,150
cons: About a 1.5-hour drive from Phayao town and Kwan Phayao
Not ideal if your main goal is to see Kwan Phayao
A small homestay with only a few bungalows, built around nature more than luxury

entries.type: 3★ Budget City · walk to the lake
entries.name: Sabuy Best Hotel Phayao
entries.badge: 🚶 Walk to the lake ~300 m · easy budget
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Phahonyothin Road · Tha Wang Thong · ~300 m walk to the lake
entries.addr: 939 Phahonyothin Road, Tha Wang Thong, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: Sabuy Best Hotel Phayao is a 3-star budget city hotel of 25 rooms on Phahonyothin Road in Tha Wang Thong subdistrict, aimed at those who want to sleep in town within walking distance of the lake on one of the easiest budgets around. It scores about 8.4 on Agoda and Trip.com from around 38 real guest reviews. The main selling point is its location — only about 300 meters' walk to the Kwan Phayao waterfront — in an old-town area only about 120 meters from Wat Li and about 300 meters from Wat Luang Ratchasanthan, both easily walkable, with the King Ngam Mueang monument within about a 5-minute walk, so it's well-suited to anyone who wants to walk between temples and soak up the old-town atmosphere by the lake without driving. Rooms are about 24–35 sq.m., a good size for a hotel at this price, with King-bed, Twin, and 35 sq.m. Triple rooms for three people or a family. Reviews mention clean rooms, cold air-con, and bathrooms with a shower, all at a level that's good value for the price. There's breakfast and free parking out front, and the Phayao bus station is about a 5-minute drive away, so it's convenient whether you drive yourself or arrive by coach. Prices start at around ฿612/night, among the lightest budgets for a walk-to-the-lake location. Honest caveats from the reviews: it's a budget hotel focused on value and location more than atmosphere or bold design, there's no pool, and the parking out front is limited when the hotel is full. Best for budget travelers who want to sleep in town within walking distance of the lake and the major temples, without paying a lot and without minding the lack of luxury facilities.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: The location stands out for walking to the lake and to Wat Li and Wat Luang Ratchasanthan, an easy base for exploring the old town on foot. If you're coming as three, choose the spacious 35 sq.m. Standard Triple, which beats booking two rooms. Parking out front is limited, so arriving before evening is more reassuring.
pros: Only about 300 m walk to the Kwan Phayao waterfront, and walkable to Wat Li and Wat Luang Ratchasanthan
Clean rooms of 24–35 sq.m., a good size for this price
Has breakfast and free parking out front
Among the lightest budgets, from around 612 for a walk-to-the-lake location
cons: A budget hotel focused on value and location more than atmosphere or design
No pool
Parking out front is limited

entries.name: Kanlaya House Resort
entries.badge: 💰 Lightest price in the set · from around 500
entries.mrtTag: 📍 Tha Wang Thong · outside Phayao town · ~4 km from the lake (8-min drive)
tags: 💰 From around 500, cheapest in the set
entries.addr: 178/1 Moo 9, Tha Wang Thong, Mueang Phayao
entries.storyHtml: We close the 10 Phayao stays with the lightest-priced option in this article — Kanlaya House Resort is a small 2-star bungalow resort of about 10 rooms in Tha Wang Thong subdistrict, outside Phayao town, where prices start at only about ฿500/night, the cheapest in this set. It scores about 8.0 on Agoda and Booking from around 12 real guest reviews. What makes people choose it is that it's single-storey bungalows with a garden, quiet, with free parking at your door, very handy for those who drive and want to park right in front of their own room, plus free bikes to ride around the grounds for anyone who wants an easy spin. There are several room types, from Standard Double and Standard Twin for couples or friends up to a Garden View room with a private balcony where you can sip morning coffee in the garden. The rooms have the essentials for the price — air-con, TV, fridge, kettle, and free Wi-Fi. The location is about 4 km from Kwan Phayao (around an 8-minute drive), with the Phayao city center and restaurant area about 7–10 minutes' drive, so it's not too far if you have a car. Honest caveats from the reviews: this is a small budget bungalow resort with simple facilities for the price, no pool or on-site restaurant, the review base is still small so compare a few sites before booking, and it's out of town, so it's better for those with a car — not a walk-to-everything location like the lakeside stays. Best for very budget-minded travelers who drive themselves and want a quiet, private bungalow with a garden at the lightest price in Phayao.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you want to sit in the garden in the morning, choose a Garden View room with a balcony. Plan to drive yourself, since it's out of town about 4 km from the lake, and you can borrow the resort's free bikes for a ride around. The review base is still small, so compare 3 sites before booking.
pros: Lightest price in the set, from only around 500/night
Single-storey bungalows with a garden, quiet and private
Free bikes to ride · free parking at your door
Garden View rooms have a balcony for sitting in the garden in the morning
cons: A small bungalow resort with simple facilities for the price

adviceTitle: How do you pick a Phayao stay that fits your trip?

advice.head: Want to sleep in town, walk to Kwan Phayao
advice.bodyHtml: → Phuglong Hotel ฿850, modern rooms with a lake view, highest score · or Sabuy Best ฿612, walk to the lake ~300 m on an easy budget

advice.head: Driving yourself, want to be in town, with breakfast
advice.bodyHtml: → M2 Hotel Phayao ฿700, city center, free parking + EV charger, breakfast at Happy Mori Cafe with good coffee

advice.head: Want an in-town stay with a pool
advice.bodyHtml: → Green Hill Hotel ฿900, an in-town hotel with an outdoor pool and poolside cafe, most reviews in the set

advice.head: Want a spacious house with a kitchen, quiet

noteHtml: 📌 Note: All prices are approximate starting prices from the standard-room range and may change by date and season; we recommend checking the real price and comparing 3 sites before every booking. The scores and highlights in this article come from reading real guest reviews on booking platforms — we did not stay ourselves. Phayao is a small town, and many stays have few rooms (some just 4–10), so they fill up fast on long weekends and festivals — book ahead. Stays in the Mae Ka / outskirts / Chiang Muan areas suit those who drive; without a car, choose a stay in town by the lake. Phayao has no airport of its own — the nearest is Chiang Rai (CEI), about 90 km away (around a 1.5-hr drive). Article by ThailandAddict.com
faqTitle: FAQ — questions travelers often ask about staying in Phayao

faq.q: ❓ Which is the best place to stay in Phayao?
faq.a: It depends on your trip style. By review score and a walk-to-the-lake location, Phuglong Hotel scores about 9.6 on Trip.com and is TripAdvisor #1 among B&Bs in Mueang Phayao. By pure average score, I Ya Guesthouse is highest at about 9.8 (a small 4-room guesthouse). For an in-town stay with breakfast and free parking, M2 Hotel. For a pool in town, Green Hill. And for a quiet house with a kitchen, Zen Home Resort & Garden.

faq.q: ❓ How much do Phayao stays cost?
faq.a: In this article, prices start at around ฿500–1,290 per night. On the lightest end are Kanlaya House from ฿500 and Sabuy Best from ฿612. In the middle are M2 and I Ya from ฿700, Phuglong ฿850, and Green Hill and DD Garden ฿900. On the higher end are the garden resort/farmstay/homestay options — Siri Garden ฿1,150, Zen Home ฿1,200, and MonSamKien ฿1,290. All prices are approximate starting prices from standard rooms; on long weekends and festivals prices may be higher than usual.

faq.q: ❓ Which area is good to stay in Phayao if you want to visit Kwan Phayao?
faq.a: If your main goal is to see Kwan Phayao and walk there without driving, choose a stay in town by the lake such as Phuglong (5-min walk), Sabuy Best (~300 m walk), Green Hill, and M2 (near the lake). Meanwhile, stays in the Mae Ka (Zen Home, MonSamKien), outskirts (I Ya), Ban Tam (DD Garden), Tha Wang Thong (Kanlaya), and Chiang Muan (Siri Garden) areas are outside the walkable zone, better for those who drive and want quiet and a garden setting.

faq.q: ❓ Which Phayao stay is good for families / with kids?
faq.a: The most family- and kid-friendly is MonSamKien Homestay, a treehouse farmstay with horse riding, kayaking, and make-your-own pizza where kids can play all day. Next is Zen Home Resort & Garden, with spacious houses that have a living room and their own kitchen, good for families who want to cook. And DD Garden Home, with spacious garden-view rooms and a faux waterfall.

faq.q: ❓ Which Phayao stays have a pool?
faq.a: In this set, most stays are small hotels and guesthouses without a pool. The option that clearly has a pool is Green Hill Hotel Phayao, with an outdoor pool and a poolside cafe, plus Pool / Lake View rooms that look out over both the pool and Kwan Phayao. If a pool matters for your trip, Green Hill is the most fitting answer in this group.

faq.q: ❓ Coming to Phayao without your own car, where should you stay?
faq.a: Without your own car, choose a stay in town by the lake where you can walk to everything such as Phuglong, Sabuy Best, Green Hill, and M2, which are within walking distance of Kwan Phayao, the night market, and restaurants. Avoid stays in the Mae Ka (Zen Home, MonSamKien), Mae Puem (I Ya), Ban Tam (DD Garden), Tha Wang Thong (Kanlaya), and Chiang Muan (Siri Garden) areas, which are out of town and better suited to those with a car. Phayao has little public transport in town, so calling a ride into town from outside can be inconvenient and add to the cost.
